text: The Patriots are riding genuine momentum after their 29-26 upset over the Bills in Week 4—a victory that saw Drake Maye rebound from an early-season rough patch with a clutch performance, and one that coach Mike Vrabel deemed critical for the defending AFC East champs as they clawed back from a 1-3 start to reach 2-2 alongside similar Week 4 resurrections by the Rams and Cowboys. The roster continues to shuffle with linebacker Jose Ramirez released and cornerback Al'Zillion Hamilton added to the practice squad, while the offense's breakthrough against Buffalo has sparked debate about whether the Patriots are genuinely back on track—though next Sunday's challenge against Las Vegas looms large, with the Raiders presenting a formidable tight end duo in Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer after the Patriots managed to shut down Dalton Kincaid in Week 4. Beyond the field, the organization will honor Pro Football Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri during halftime against the Raiders on October 11, and high school coach John Dubzinski of Central Catholic earned the Patriots Coach of the Week honor after leading the Raiders to a 52-51 upset of Xaverian Brothers.
